content.short: Adaz is a Cardano NFT collection of 900 AI-generated portraits inspired by Ada Lovelace art series today.
content.description: Adaz is a Cardano NFT collection made from AI-generated portraits inspired by Alfred Edward Chalon's 1838 portrait of Ada Lovelace. The project created 900 unique Adaz portraits using machine learning, turning a historic image into a collectible generative art series. Collectors can also pursue bloodline sets, where gathering all five Adaz from a bloodline unlocks the ability to mint one of 100 animated bloodline NFTs. The collection blends Cardano culture, art history, and AI-assisted digital portraiture.
content.meta: Adaz turns Ada Lovelace-inspired AI portraits into a 900-piece Cardano NFT collection. Explore Adaz on Lancers Web3 Explorer today.
